title: Mixed Event — On This Holy Night, I Sing — Episode4 How I Used to Sing

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing
meta.Episode: Episode4 — How I Used to Sing
meta.Event Outline: For their second show for the Show Contest, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are preparing a Christmas-themed musical! However, a prima donna with a voice powerful enough to shock even Nene stands in their path...! Curtains open for these two songstresses as they each put their pride on the line!

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That wasn't any good either. I need to modulate my voice better...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene, how much longer do you plan on singing? We have other scenes to rehearse, you know.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! Did you even hear what I just said?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Rui, I'm worried about Nene.
She's been practicing that song all morning...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, would you mind coming over here for a moment?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What is it? I'm busy now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I may have an idea regarding what's missing in your songs.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-You do?
What is it...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Before I tell you, would you mind singing once more? I need to make sure my suspicions are correct.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then I'll sing on the stage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Inhales*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... I think she sounds as good as she always does.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Nene's falsetto and vibratos were terrific. She didn't miss a note anywhere either...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's exactly as I thought...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you, Nene.
That will be enough.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What am I missing?
What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your problem is that you're holding back your emotions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. She's the exact opposite of extroverts, such as the Phoenix Stage singer or you two.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, you may not realize it, but you're being too careful with how you express yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is not to say that being in control is not important, but putting your genuine emotions into a performance is at the top of that list.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You should allow your feelings to flow into the song, so that your audience will feel them too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In this case, your serious and focused approach is preventing you from doing that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your technique is perfect. I believe this is the only factor which gives your rival the edge.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So... You're saying Nene just needs to relax more?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To put it simply, yes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it's not simple at all...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know how to be more emotional when I sing. How can I do that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well... There must be a reason you're holding back.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I can't remember my next line!
What should I do? What should I do!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... I thought I got over that a long time ago...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe you haven't quite...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
How did you sing before what happened?
That might give you a clue as to what to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Before...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know if that's going to help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, we're done for the day!
Time to go home!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What are we to do...?
If Nene is in this much of a slump...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene will find her way...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's capable of pinpointing what's nagging at her deep down and confronting it on her own.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... I just can't help worrying about her... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Whoa! My phone lit up!
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hello, everyone! Miku here♪ How is everyone doing?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's Miku...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Miku! It's great to see you again!
It's been a while since you last visited!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Great to see you too! I came to invite you all to see our brand new show!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A new show?
What've you come up with this time?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <A festively fun Christmas show!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And! It'll feature our new member!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Someone new?! I can't wait to see who!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Who is it?!
Tell me, tell me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehehe♪ You'll have to come to SEKAI to find out♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Shall I teleport you all to SEKAI now...?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I don't feel like it right now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm going home...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh no... Did something happen to Nene?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Kind of... We're working on a new show ourselves, but Nene has hit a bit of a roadblock...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How I used to sing before...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's not like I can just flip a switch...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Well, well. If it isn't Kusanagi from the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Seiryuin...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Why are you moping around with that pitiful look on your face? Have you realized that your troupe cannot hope to ever surpass mine?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't be so sure of...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Oh dear... At this rate, your show might not even be worth seeing.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Would you do everyone a favor and just give up instead of ruining Phoenix Wonderland's reputation with your embarrassing attempts at entertainment?
